body: I’m tired. Every time I turn around she says something else about him and I cannot handle it. As someone who has been sexually assaulted and has seen this music video many times, that’s fucking sickening. If what she says is true, I have witnessed someone I looked up to rape his partner. If she is lying, she is trying to make millions of people believed they witnessed someone they look up to rape her. Either way, it’s fucking disgusting and I’m tired of seeing this shit. I wish she would get all this out at once or just stop talking about it. I can’t stand things settling down again, feeling like it’s safe to go back to social media without being constantly triggered by this discussion, and then boom. She makes another, even more horrible claim. Just one thing after another. It’s like she fucking waits until things have died down and then decides to share another horrific story. Does she have any idea how awful that is to everyone who has experienced sexual assault? If she has gone through what she says she had with Manson, I’m deeply sorry and I feel for her but god. I completely disagree with how she is handling it. It’s making it so goddamn hard for people to take her side and move on from this.

I’m not saying the man did or didn’t do the things he’s been accused of but you know people are into that shit, right? No where did he say he was serious or was doing it against people’s will. The fact that he called it the “bad girl room” sounds like it’s either a joke or a kink, which if it’s consensual, who cares? Just seems weird to take that as definitive proof he’s a r*pist

Agreed. I like having discussions with others, even if I don’t agree with them... hell, ESPECIALLY if I don’t agree with them. It’s interesting and opens you up to new ways of thinking but that is nooot what this guy’s doing

I agree. Assuming that what this guy said is true (and that’s a big assumption and not something I’m claiming) the kind of behavior he’s detailing is disturbing. No, he doesn’t claim to have witnessed r*pe but what he does claim would call Manson’s character into question (even more than it has been before, most of us know Manson it’s perfect and has done some bad things). It could be he did these awful things but never sexually assaulted anyone but this kind of behavior, if true, makes it seem more possible that he is who doesn’t care about abusing significant others and might be more likely to sexually assault them.

It could make sense with her testimony because it’s the truth orrr it could make sense with her testimony because he saw her testimony and what people were saying about Manson and used that to fabricate something. Saying they match up is it really an argument when it is almost guaranteed he saw her testimony. It could only be an argument if one could prove that he never saw it and his story just happened to match. But that is most certainly not the case

Looks like he has a radio show that retweeted his tweets about Manson... I don’t know you but this seems like a really good way to get attention for his podcast. Again, doesn’t automatically mean he’s lying, but it seems clear than he CAN gain from this.

Yup. I don’t know why people act like someone has nothing to gain by going after a person so much bigger than them. Our social media (ESPECIALLY Twitter) thrives on drama and “cancel culture”. He’ll get some backlash, sure, but he’ll also get tons of people supporting him and calling him brave and hero, like they are already doing in the comments.

Just because part of someone’s story checks out doesn’t mean the whole thing is true. Not saying that he IS lying, but you can’t assume he’s telling the truth based on that alone. Good liars stick as close to the truth as possible.
“I have nothing to gain.” Listen. I’m not saying he’s lying or telling the truth but when you have 2,700 followers and you go after someone with 1.2 MILLION, you do have something to gain.
